general.sub: Kit summary · pick a hero talent above

i: Use Fury of Elune (1 min) on cooldown, but nudge it into Lunar Eclipse or Incarnation: Chosen of Elune. With Lunation, each Arcane spell cuts its cooldown by 1.5 sec
With Lunar Calling, Starfire hits the primary target 120% harder and Wrath does not change Eclipse mode. Fill with Starfire even on single target
With Boundless Moonlight, Fury of Elune bursts astral damage on nearby enemies once more when it ends. Use it after grouping enemies
The hero talent Wowhead recommends for both raid and Mythic+ (★ for Mythic+ in the build table)
Summon 3 treants with Force of Nature (1 min) and pop Incarnation: Chosen of Elune on the next GCD. While treants are out, Harmony of the Grove raises spell damage by 4% each
With Dream Surge, the 3 Wrath / Starfire casts after Force of Nature burst nature damage around the target
Use Solar Eclipse and Wrath on 3 or fewer targets, Lunar Eclipse and Starfire on 4 or more (Wowhead)
Use Wild Mushroom (3 charges) to build Astral Power while moving
Incarnation: Chosen of Elune · 3 min · both Eclipse effects and 10% crit for 20 sec. Line it up with big pulls and boss burst windows
Eclipse · 32 sec · 15 sec of Solar Eclipse (Nature 15%, Wrath 40%) or Lunar Eclipse (Arcane 15%, Starfire 40%). The mode follows your last Wrath / Starfire
Fury of Elune · 1 min · beam that follows the enemy for 8 sec, generates 40 Astral Power (Elune's Chosen)
Force of Nature · 1 min · 3 treants for 10 sec, generates 20 Astral Power (Keeper of the Grove)
Barkskin · 1 min · 30% damage taken reduction for 12 sec (Improved Barkskin / Oakskin), usable while stunned or feared
Bear Form + Frenzied Regeneration · 36 sec · 220% Armor and 25% health, heals 24% health over 3 sec. Breaks your damage, so only when in danger
Heart of the Wild · 2 min · used while not shapeshifted, empowers AoE healing (30 yards around the target, up to 5 allies)

Solar Beam · 1 min · interrupts the target and silences all enemies in the beam for 8 sec. Long cooldown, so take only one slot in the interrupt rotation; used on grouped enemies it stops several casts
Incapacitating Roar · 30 sec · shifts into bear and incapacitates all enemies within 10 yards for 3 sec. Stops an add pack's casts at once (damage may break it)
Group scattered adds with Typhoon (30 sec, 15-yard frontal knockback) + Ursol's Vortex (1 min, 8-yard snare then one pull-in)
Remove Corruption · 8 sec · removes all curses and poisons from an ally. Soothe (10 sec) removes enrage effects from enemies
Shapeshifting (Bear Form, Moonkin Form, etc.) frees you from movement-impairing effects. Shapeshift out of roots and snares
Wild Charge · 15 sec · fly to a nearby ally. Stampeding Roar · 1 min (Improved Stampeding Roar) · 60% movement speed for allies within 15 yards for 8 sec
Mark of the Wild · 3% Versatility for the party. Battle res: Rebirth
Ascendant week: you can handle orbs almost alone with Incapacitating Roar and Typhoon. Don't rush when orbs spawn; let them gather first (Wowhead)
Voidbound week: bank Astral Power before the Void Emissary spawns, then dump it all at once. Balance is weak at killing the Emissary, so kill it with the party (Wowhead)
Pulsar week: stand close to melee and use AoE CC and the orbs clear themselves. If you are apart, walk toward the party to share the orbs (Wowhead)
Devour week: dispel twice per 15 sec debuff with Remove Corruption (Wowhead)
Xal'atath's Guile at +12 and above: 15 sec lost per death

Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Put Solar Beam into the kick rotation for Fractured Shivercore's Winter's Shroud

99.d: 곰으로 변신하여 우르솔의 혼을 일깨워 귀청이 터질 듯한 포효를 내지릅니다. 10미터 안에 있는 모든 적을 3초 동안 행동 불가 상태로 만듭니다. 대상이 피해를 받으면 효과가 사라질 수 있습니다.

783.d:
현재 위치에 따라 빠른 이동에 알맞은 모습으로 변신합니다. 땅 위나 물속, 또는 하늘에서 이동 속도가 증가하고, 변이 효과에 면역이 됩니다.

변신을 하면 이동 방해 효과에서 벗어납니다.

1126.d:
아군 대상에게 야생의 힘을 주입하여 60분 동안 유연성을 3%만큼 증가시킵니다.

대상이 같은 파티나 공격대에 속해 있다면, 모든 파티원과 공격대원이 효과를 받습니다.

1850.d: 표범으로 변신하여 10초 동안 이동 속도가 60%만큼 증가합니다.

2782.m: 특성 · 10% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 8 초 재사용 대기시간
2782.d: 아군 대상에 걸린 해로운 효과를 무력화하여, 모든 저주 및 독 효과를 해제합니다.

2908.m: 특성 · 1.12% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 10 초 재사용 대기시간
2908.d: 대상을 달래 모든 격노 효과를 제거합니다.

5176.m: 0.2% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간

5487.d:
곰 모습으로 변신합니다. 방어도가 220%만큼, 체력이 25%만큼 증가합니다. 변이 효과에 면역이 되고, 위협 수준 생성량이 증가합니다.

변신을 하면 이동 방해 효과에서 벗어납니다.

8921.d: 빠르게 달빛 광선을 비추며 적을 불태워 (주문력의 21.2%)의 비전 피해를 입히고 추가로 18초에 걸쳐 (주문력의 165.6%)의 비전 피해를 입힙니다.

8936.m: 10% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간
8936.d: 아군 대상의 생명력을 (주문력의 536%)만큼 회복시키고 추가로 6초에 걸쳐 [(주문력의 67.4904%) * 1]만큼 회복시킵니다.

20484.m: 분노 30 / 2% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 2 초 주문 시전 시간 · 10 분 재사용 대기시간
20484.d: 죽은 자의 영혼을 육체로 불러들여 100%의 생명력과 최소 20%의 마나를 지니고 살아나게 합니다. 전투 중에도 사용할 수 있습니다.

22812.d:
피부가 나무 껍질처럼 단단해집니다. 받는 모든 피해가 20%만큼 감소하고 피해를 받아도 주문 시전이 지연되지 않습니다. 8초 동안 지속됩니다.

기절, 얼어붙음, 행동 불가, 공포, 수면 상태 및 모든 변신 상태에서 사용할 수 있습니다.

22842.m: 특성 · 분노 10 · 즉시 · 36 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능 · 곰 변신 필요

24858.d:
달빛야수의 모습으로 변신합니다. 주문 공격력이 10%만큼, 방어도가 125%만큼 증가하고, 변이 효과에 면역이 됩니다.

변신을 하면 이동 방해 효과에서 벗어납니다.

78674.m: 특성 · 천공의 힘 40 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
78674.d: 쇄도하는 항성 에너지를 대상에게 내보내 (주문력의 367.6%)의 천공 피해를 입힙니다.

78675.m: 특성 · 3.36% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
78675.d: 적 대상의 위치에 태양 광선을 소환하여 대상의 주문 시전을 방해하고, 태양 광선 안에 있는 모든 적을 침묵시킵니다. 8초 동안 지속됩니다.

88747.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간 · 3회 사용 가능
88747.d:
대상 적의 위치에 마법 버섯을 자라나게 합니다. 1초 후에 버섯이 폭발해 (주문력의 318.7%)의 자연 피해를 입히고 10초에 걸쳐 (주문력의 180%)의 추가 자연 피해를 입힙니다. 영향을 받는 대상은 이동 속도가 50%만큼 감소합니다.

적중당한 대상에 따라 최대 20의 천공의 힘을 생성합니다.

93402.m: 특성 · 1.8% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
93402.d: 빠르게 태양 광선을 비추어 적을 불태워 (주문력의 21.2%)의 자연 피해를 입히고 추가로 18초에 걸쳐 (주문력의 165.6%)의 추가 자연 피해를 입힙니다.

102401.m: 특성 · 5 - 25 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간

102560.m: 특성 · 천체의 정렬을(를) 대신함 · 즉시 · 3 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
102560.d:
강화된 달빛야수 형태로, 두 일월식 효과와 습득한 천체의 정렬 추가 효과를 부여하고 치명타 및 극대화 확률이 10%만큼 증가합니다.

20초 동안 지속됩니다. 지속시간 동안 강화된 달빛야수 외의 다른 모습으로 변신하거나 돌아올 수 있습니다.

102793.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
102793.d: 대상 위치에 10초 동안 회오리를 일으켜, 8미터 내 모든 적의 이동 속도를 50%만큼 감소시킵니다. 적이 처음으로 회오리를 벗어나려 하면 중앙으로 한 번 끌려갑니다. 모든 변신 상태에서 사용할 수 있습니다.

106898.m: 특성 · 10 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
106898.d: 곰으로 변신하여 우렁찬 함성을 내질러 8초 동안 15미터 내의 모든 아군 플레이어의 이동 속도를 60%만큼 증가시킵니다.

132469.m: 특성 · 15 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
132469.d: 전방 15미터 안의 적들을 맹렬한 태풍으로 강타해 뒤로 밀쳐내고, 6초 동안 이동 속도를 50%만큼 감소시킵니다. 모든 변신 상태에서 사용할 수 있습니다.

191034.d: 40미터 내의 적에게 별똥별을 연쇄적으로 떨어뜨려 8초에 걸쳐 [9 * (주문력의 27%)]의 천공 피해를 입힙니다. 이 능력은 여러 번 중첩해서 사용할 수 있습니다. [에테르 덧불: 활성화되어 있는 달빛섬광과 태양섬광의 지속시간이 3초만큼 증가합니다]

194153.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 2.25 초 주문 시전 시간
194153.d:
강력한 에너지를 불러내 적을 강타하여 대상에게 (주문력의 121.8%)의 비전 피해를 입히고, 10미터 내의 다른 모든 적에게 [(주문력의 121.8%) * 70 / 100]의 비전 피해를 입힙니다. 8명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

천공의 힘을 생성합니다.

202342.d: 달빛섬광과 태양섬광이 지속 피해를 입힐 때마다 일정 확률로 별똥별을 떨어뜨려 (주문력의 68%)의 천공 피해를 입히고 2의 천공의 힘을 생성합니다.

202345.d:
별빛쇄도와 별똥별 시전 시 20초 동안 혹은 새로운 일월식 상태에 돌입할 때까지 가속이 2%만큼 증가합니다.

최대 3번까지 중첩됩니다. 중첩 시 지속시간이 갱신되지 않습니다.

202770.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
202770.d:
적을 추적하는 순수한 천공 에너지를 불러 내려, 대상 지역 내의 모든 적에게 8초에 걸쳐 최대 [8 * 2 * (주문력의 18.34%)]의 천공 피해를 입힙니다. 부가 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

지속시간에 걸쳐 40의 천공의 힘을 생성합니다.

205636.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
205636.d:
나무정령 3마리를 소환합니다. 나무정령은 소환 즉시 대상 지역의 적을 도발하고 주위의 적을 공격하며 10초 후에 사라집니다.

20의 천공의 힘을 생성합니다.

279620.d: 달빛섬광의 공격력이 10%만큼 증가하고, 대상으로부터 15미터 내에 있는 적에게 추가로 적중합니다.

327541.d: 별똥별 시전 시 활성화되어 있는 달빛섬광과 태양섬광의 지속시간이 최대 28초까지 3.0초만큼 증가합니다.

383197.d: 유성이 30번째 주기마다 대상에게 보름달을 50%의 효율로 떨어뜨립니다. (100밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

393760.d: 천벌 및 별빛섬광이 20%의 확률로 일월식 상태일 때 시전하는 다음 천벌이나 별빛섬광이 천공 피해를 입히며 공격력은 75%만큼 증가합니다.

393940.d: 별빛쇄도가 20%의 확률로 별똥별의 자원 소모량을 없애고, 별똥별은 40%의 확률로 별빛쇄도의 자원 소모량을 없앱니다.

393954.d: 별빛쇄도와 별똥별의 공격력이 8%만큼 증가하고 자원 소모량은 10%만큼 감소합니다.

424058.d:
엘룬의 분노

보름달

428544.d: 자연의 군대 나무정령이 6초마다 한 번씩 주위의 대상에게 달빛섬광을 시전합니다.

428731.d: 자연의 군대가 활성화된 동안 각 나무정령 하나당 시전자의 주문 공격력이 4%만큼 증가합니다.

429520.d: 달빛섬광 및 별빛섬광이 2의 천공의 힘을 추가로 생성합니다.

429523.d:
별빛섬광이 주 대상에게 120%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다.

천벌을 시전해도 일월식 능력이 일식으로 변경되지 않습니다.

429536.d:
화신: 엘룬의 선택이 활성화된 동안 주문 및 능력의 비전 공격력이 10%만큼 증가합니다.

영혼 소집의 지속시간과 시전되는 주문의 수가 25%만큼 증가합니다.

429539.d: 비전 능력 사용 시 엘룬의 분노의 재사용 대기시간이 1.5초만큼, 초승달과 반달, 보름달의 재사용 대기시간이 1.0초만큼 감소합니다.

433831.d: 자연의 군대 시전 시 꿈의 폭발 3중첩이 부여되어, 다음 천벌 또는 별빛섬광이 주위의 적에게 [(전투력의 393%) * 1.06]의 자연 피해를 입히도록 합니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

443046.d: 곰 변신 또는 달빛야수 변신 상태로 야생의 돌진 사용 시 재사용 대기시간이 3초만큼 감소합니다.

449191.d: 생존 본능과 나무 껍질이 받는 피해를 추가로 10%만큼 감소시킵니다.

450356.d:
천벌 시전 시 12%의 확률로 다음 별빛쇄도 또는 별똥별이 자원을 소모하지 않습니다.

별빛섬광 시전 시 15%의 확률로 다음 별빛쇄도 또는 별똥별이 자원을 소모하지 않습니다.

468936.m: 특성 · 매 분마다 약 1.66번 효과 발동됨
468936.d:
태양섬광으로 피해를 입히면 일정 확률로 대상의 위치에 마법 버섯을 자라나게 합니다. 1초 후에 버섯이 폭발해 (주문력의 265.85%)의 자연 피해를 입히고 10초에 걸쳐 (주문력의 150%)의 추가 자연 피해를 입힙니다. 영향을 받는 대상은 이동 속도가 50%만큼 감소합니다.

적중당한 대상에 따라 최대 20의 천공의 힘을 생성합니다.

474678.d:
한 번의 공격으로 최대 생명력의 12% 이상에 해당하는 피해를 받으면 즉시 10%의 생명력을 회복합니다.

이 효과는 30초에 한 번씩만 발동합니다. (30초 재사용 대기시간)

1233272.m: 즉시 · 32 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
1233272.d:
월식에 돌입하여 15초 동안 별빛섬광을 강화합니다.

천벌을 시전하면 일식으로 변화합니다.

비전 주문의 공격력이 15%만큼, 별빛섬광의 공격력은 40%만큼 증가합니다.

1233346.m: 즉시 · 32 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
1233346.d:
일식에 돌입하여 15초 동안 천벌을 강화합니다.

별빛섬광을 시전하면 월식으로 변화합니다.

일월식 (태양)
자연 주문의 공격력이 15%만큼, 천벌의 공격력은 40%만큼 증가합니다.

1239669.d:
15초 동안 태양과 달을 정렬시켜 자연 또는 비전 주문을 강화합니다. 천벌 또는 별빛섬광 중 어떤 주문을 시전하느냐에 따라 진입하는 일월식 모드가 결정되며, 일월식의 두 모드는 하나의 버튼을 공유하고 32초의 재사용 대기시간이 적용됩니다.

일월식 (태양)
자연 주문이 15%의 추가 피해를 입히고 천벌의 공격력은 40%만큼 증가합니다.

일월식 (달)
비전 주문이 15%의 추가 피해를 입히고 별빛섬광의 공격력은 40%만큼 증가합니다.

1240907.d: 별똥별이 별의 물결을 떨어뜨릴 때마다 사정거리 내 최대 2명의 대상에게 추가로 유성 파편을 떨어뜨려 각각 (주문력의 21.95%)의 천공 피해를 입힙니다.

1261564.d: 일월식 활성화 시 다음 천벌 또는 별빛섬광이 즉시 시전됩니다. 일월식의 지속시간 동안 처음 3번 시전하는 별빛쇄도 또는 별똥별은 20%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다. (100밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

1261867.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
1261867.d:
현재 활성화된 변신 형상에 따라 강력한 비역할 능력을 사용합니다.

인간형:
강화된 급속 성장을 시전하여 대상의 30미터 내에 있는 최대 5명의 부상당한 아군을 7초에 걸쳐 [(주문력의 336.7%) * 750 / 100]만큼 치유합니다.

1: [차단] Put Solar Beam (1 min) into the kick rotation for Radiant Spellsower's Light Bolt Volley (4 sec cast, 174568 Holy). With a 1 min cooldown it covers only one kick in this pull; drop the beam after the tank has gathered the pack and every other mob inside it is silenced for 8 sec as well.

[제어] When a Spellsower gets low, place Ursol's Vortex (1 min) under it in advance. If it tries to run to a dormant Lasher pack with Call The Grove, it is pulled back to the center once and Frantic Blooming is delayed.

[광역 피해] Once everything is stacked and Bloodlust is up, press Incarnation: Chosen of Elune (3 min) together with Fury of Elune (1 min, Elune's Chosen build) or Force of Nature (1 min, Keeper of the Grove build). Press Barkskin (1 min, 30% damage reduction for 12 sec) for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret (87284 Holy every 2 sec for 6 sec).
2: [차단] When both Radiant Spellsowers cast Light Bolt Volley, drop Solar Beam on the two stacked at the tank to silence both at once. If the Solar Beam from pull 1 is not back, step within 10 yards and stop both casts with Incapacitating Roar (30 sec, 3 sec incapacitate).
[광역 피해] Use Barkskin for Spouting Floret. If the Barkskin from pull 1 (1 min) is not back, shift to Bear Form and survive with Frenzied Regeneration (36 sec, heals 24% health over 3 sec).
3: [제어] Two Radiant Spellsowers sit next to 12 Lashers, so place Ursol's Vortex under a Spellsower before it gets low to stop it from running with Call The Grove. Stop Light Bolt Volley with Solar Beam or Incapacitating Roar.

[우선 처치] A Lightgorged Lasher with its Lightbloom Pollination shield (absorbs 600108) is immune to crowd control, so do not waste Incapacitating Roar or Typhoon on it; focus Starsurge on that Lasher to break the shield first.
5: [차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech (4 sec cast) with Solar Beam. If it goes off, the whole group is disoriented for 3 sec.
[광역 피해] Use Barkskin on the first-pulled Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret, and move into Lunar Eclipse and Starfall once the Virid Grovekeeper arriving 5-6 sec later is stacked too.

[제어] Neither Balance Mythic+ build has a stun. Leave stunning Thorny Saptor's Thornclaw Leap to a party member who has one, and if a Saptor leaps at you, Wild Charge (15 sec) to the tank to escape the follow-up cone attacks.
7: [차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech with Solar Beam. If Solar Beam is not back, walk up to the Petalwing and stop it with Incapacitating Roar.

[광역 피해] The two Luminous Thornmaws have a lot of health and live long, so time Fury of Elune (Elune's Chosen build) or Force of Nature (Keeper of the Grove build) for this pull, and add Incarnation: Chosen of Elune if it is back.
[참고] While Spineshield Beetle's Spiny Shield is up on the 5 beetles, every Starfall hit returns 4849 Nature damage. Press Barkskin together with Starfall.
8: [광역 피해] Use Barkskin for Spouting Floret. If the Barkskin used on pull 7 (1 min) is not back, use Heart of the Wild (2 min) while not shapeshifted to put an empowered group heal on up to 5 allies within 30 yards and help your healer.
10: [해제] You can remove Potatoad Matriarch's Toxic Spew (67888 Nature plus a 9 sec poison DoT) with Remove Corruption (Wowhead). With an 8 sec cooldown it clears one player at a time, so split the work with your healer and start with the lowest player.

[우선 처치] When the two Lightgorged Lashers activate Lightbloom Pollination shields, nearby mobs gain 50% attack speed, so focus Starsurge on that Lasher and break the shield (600108). Time Fury of Elune or Force of Nature for the high-health Matriarch.
11: [차단] When all three Lightfeather Petalwings cast Disorienting Screech, drop Solar Beam on the three stacked at the tank to silence them at once, and stop the rest with Incapacitating Roar.
[광역 피해] Use Barkskin for Spouting Floret. If you used Barkskin on pull 10, check that 1 min has passed; if not, take it with Bear Form and Frenzied Regeneration.
12: [우선 처치] When the six Lightgorged Lashers activate Lightbloom Pollination shields, stack Incarnation: Chosen of Elune with Fury of Elune or Force of Nature on this pull and break the shields together with Lunar Eclipse and Starfall.

[차단] Silence both Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley at once with Solar Beam, and place Ursol's Vortex under a Spellsower that tries to run with Call The Grove. Press Barkskin for Spouting Floret.

1: [제어] When the 7 Ravenous Descendants live long and stack Ravenous Claws attack speed, drop Ursol's Vortex (1 min) at the tank's feet. While the vortex slows them by 50%, the tank gains distance and breaks the stacks (Wowhead).
[차단] Each Primal Serpent needs its own kicker. Take one Serpent's Piercing Hiss (4 sec cast) with Solar Beam (1 min).
[해제] If Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots hits you (67888 Nature plus 48491 every sec for 20 sec, 10% slow per tick), shapeshift to clear the slow and the DoT together (Wowhead).
2: [광역 피해] Ritual Chieftain's Blood Sacrifice (87284 Physical to the whole group plus a 162029 heal absorb) hurts most in this pull, so use Barkskin (1 min, 30% damage reduction for 12 sec) here.
[우선 처치] Focus Starsurge on the Ritual Chieftain to kill it first. Unstable Totem deals 29095 Nature every 2 sec while the Chieftain lives.
[차단] Kick Primal Serpent's Piercing Hiss with Solar Beam. If Solar Beam from pull 1 is not back, step within 10 yards and stop it with Incapacitating Roar (30 sec, 3 sec incapacitate).
3: [차단] When the tank breaks line of sight behind the pillar, the 3 Primal Serpents walk down and stack. Drop Solar Beam on that spot to silence all three for 8 sec and let the group cover the remaining kicks.
[광역 피해] Use Barkskin for Blood Sacrifice. If Barkskin from pull 2 (1 min) is not back, shift to Bear Form and survive with Frenzied Regeneration (36 sec, heals 24% health over 3 sec).
5: [광역 피해] At 103 forces this is the biggest pull of the route, so press Incarnation: Chosen of Elune (3 min) if it is back, together with Fury of Elune (1 min, Elune's Chosen build) or Force of Nature (1 min, Keeper of the Grove build). Press Barkskin for Blood Sacrifice.
[해제] When Paralyzing Shots DoTs from the two Twinfang Harrowers stack up and slow you, shapeshift to clear the slow and the DoT (Wowhead).
7: [해제] High Evolutionist's Envenom (58189 Nature plus 24246 every sec for 8 sec) is a poison you can remove with Remove Corruption (8 sec). Clear the Envenom that lands right before Rattling Writhe's Rattle first so the DoT and the AoE do not overlap.
[차단] Kick High Evolutionist's Evolve channel (6 sec) with Solar Beam. If it completes, the caster gains a 250045 shield and crowd control immunity.
[광역 피해] Press Barkskin for Rattling Writhe's Rattle (58189 Physical every sec for 5 sec, ignores armor).
9: [차단] The far-left High Evolutionist needs a ranged player to kick it and pull it in. Solar Beam has 40 yard range, so take it as Balance: stop that Evolutionist's Mass Envenom or Evolve with Solar Beam so it walks toward the tank (Topicx).
[해제] Remove Envenom with Remove Corruption. With two Evolutionists the poison can hit several players, so split the work with your healer and clear whoever got it right before Rattle first.
11: [차단] When kicks are assigned for the 4 High Evolutionists, take one with Solar Beam. If the tank has stacked two or more, drop the beam on them to stop Evolve and Mass Envenom together for 8 sec.
[해제] All four keep casting Envenom, so press Remove Corruption (8 sec) on cooldown and clear the lowest party member first.
12: [광역 피해] Ascendant Serpent must die before its third Infest, so line up Incarnation: Chosen of Elune and Fury of Elune or Force of Nature on this miniboss (Topicx).

[위치] When everyone stacks on the tank's marked spot for Infest (34914 Nature every sec for 5 sec, then 69827 Nature within 8 yards), the bursts overlap, so press Barkskin and drop Starfall on the hatchlings that spawn there.
13: [우선 처치] If you melt the 6 Living Venoms at once with Starfall and Fury of Elune, their Venom Bursts go off together and endanger the group. Focus Starsurge on Ula'tek's Chosen first and kill the Living Venoms a few at a time with Wrath (Topicx).
[차단] Ula'tek's Chosen's Mass Envenom must be kicked every time, so put Solar Beam into the kick rotation.
[광역 피해] Press Barkskin for Toxic Surge (29095 Nature every sec for 9 sec).
14: [우선 처치] Same setup as pull 13. Do not dump AoE cooldowns into the Living Venoms at once; kill Ula'tek's Chosen first with Starsurge.
[광역 피해] Use Barkskin for Toxic Surge. If Barkskin from pull 13 (1 min) is not back, shift to Bear Form and take it with Frenzied Regeneration.
16: [광역 피해] Blood Sacrifice from the two Ritual Chieftains comes back to back and overlaps with Toxic Surge, so split Barkskin and Bear Form with Frenzied Regeneration across them. If healing falls short, use Heart of the Wild (2 min) while not shapeshifted to put an empowered group heal on up to 5 allies within 30 yards.
[우선 처치] Ula'tek's Chosen must die before its second Toxic Surge, so line up Incarnation: Chosen of Elune and your 1 min cooldown on the Chosen and focus Starsurge on it (Topicx).

1: [광역 피해] This pull brings the Bribed Captain and Bribed Guard together with Bloodlust, so press Incarnation: Chosen of Elune (3 min) with Fury of Elune (1 min, Elune's Chosen build) or Force of Nature (1 min, Keeper of the Grove build) and focus Starsurge on the Captain (Topicx).
[해제] When Street Sneak's Heartstop Poison (5% max health reduction per stack plus 193965 Nature over 8 sec) stacks on the tank, remove it with Remove Corruption (8 sec) (Topicx).

[광역 피해] If Row Hooligan's Cutpurse (38793 Physical plus a 155172 bleed over 8 sec) lands on you, press Barkskin (1 min, 30% damage reduction for 12 sec). It is especially dangerous when it overlaps with other damage (Wowhead).
2: [차단] Seductive Sayaad's Seduction (3 sec cast, 6 sec disorient) needs one kicker per Sayaad, so take one with Solar Beam (1 min) (Topicx). If both Sayaads pulled out the door by line of sight are stacked, one beam stops both.
4: [해제] Four Street Sneaks stack Heartstop Poison quickly (Topicx). Remove the tank's poison with Remove Corruption on every cooldown.
5: [우선 처치] Focus Starsurge on the Massive Felwyrm first. While it lives, Over-infused deals 38793 Fire to everyone within 50 yards every 3 sec (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Massive Felwyrm's Corroding Spittle is Magic and Balance cannot remove it. If it hits you, ask your healer for a dispel and press Barkskin.
8: [해제] Kick Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage (3.5 sec cast, 60% damage reduction and crowd control immunity for 1 min) with Solar Beam, and if it goes off, remove the Enrage with Soothe (10 sec) (Wowhead).
[우선 처치] Below 50%, Shivan Punisher pulses 29095 Fire every sec with Demonic Frenzy until it dies, so line up Fury of Elune or Force of Nature then and finish it fast (Topicx).
9: [해제] Corrupted Warlock's Curse of Doom (581895 Shadow after 10 sec, split among everyone within 4 yards of the target) is a Curse, so remove it right away with Remove Corruption (Wowhead).
[광역 피해] If Drain Life targets you, press Barkskin. If you cannot hold out, the Warlock heals a lot (Topicx).
[해제] Kick both Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage with Solar Beam and remove any remaining Enrage with Soothe.
10: [차단] Take the first Health Funnel (30 sec channel) from the Fel Invoker with Solar Beam to buy time to chain in the Demon Flies (Topicx).
[우선 처치] When Shivan Punisher drops below 50%, line up Fury of Elune or Force of Nature, and press Barkskin if the Demonic Frenzy fire damage drags on.
11: [광역 피해] Felmaster Lucsei's Blade Dance (43642 Fire every 0.4 sec for 1.2 sec) is covered by alternating personal and group defensives, so press Barkskin on your turn (Topicx).
[우선 처치] To keep Blade Dance from going out more than three times, press Incarnation: Chosen of Elune if it is back and focus Starsurge on Lucsei (Topicx).
13: [광역 피해] Press Barkskin for Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (145474 Fire to everyone). Once the Unleashed Imp pack the tank dragged in is stacked too, kill them together with Starfall (Topicx).
[해제] Kick both Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage with Solar Beam and remove any Enrage you missed with Soothe.
15: [해제] Remove Corrupted Warlock's Curse of Doom right away with Remove Corruption. Drain Life overlapping with the Punisher's Demonic Frenzy is lethal (Topicx).
[우선 처치] Focus Starsurge on the Warlock while it is pulled back and killed first, then line up your 1 min cooldown when the separately pulled Shivan Punisher drops below 50% (Topicx).
16: [광역 피해] Defiled Golem's AoE should be over within two casts (Topicx), so line up Incarnation: Chosen of Elune and your 1 min cooldown on the Golem, press Barkskin for Defiled Slam, then follow with Bear Form and Frenzied Regeneration (36 sec, heals 24% health over 3 sec).
[차단] Put Solar Beam into the kick rotation for the two Fel Invokers' Health Funnel.

1: [해제] Mother's Wrath from the two Territorial Matriarchs is an Enrage you can remove with Soothe (10 sec). Each stack adds 50% damage and movement speed and endangers the tank, so press Soothe every time the enrage goes up.

[해제] Spirit of Hunger's Insatiable Hunger (15% max health reduction, stacks) is a Curse, so remove it with Remove Corruption (8 sec). Clear it before it reaches 2 stacks while the Starvation Effigy is still alive (Wowhead).

[광역 피해] This is the first Bloodlust pull, so press Incarnation: Chosen of Elune (3 min) together with Fury of Elune (1 min, Elune's Chosen build) or Force of Nature (1 min, Keeper of the Grove build) (Topicx).
2: [차단] Put Solar Beam (1 min) into the kick rotation for Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast) and Earth Bolt (116379 Nature). Drop the beam after the tank has gathered the pack and the Tender cannot cast anything for 8 sec.
[해제] Remove Mother's Wrath with Soothe and the Insatiable Hunger curse with Remove Corruption. Balance can handle both, so clear the enrage first and then the curse.
7: [해제] With two Territorial Matriarchs, unremoved Mother's Wrath makes the physical damage heavy (Topicx). Remove the enrage with Soothe (10 sec) every time it goes up.
[차단] Stop both Earthwhisper Tenders' Healing Breeze with a single Solar Beam, and if the beam is down, step within 10 yards and stop it with Incapacitating Roar (30 sec, 3 sec incapacitate).
[광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after the boss (Topicx). Line up Fury of Elune or Force of Nature here, and add Incarnation: Chosen of Elune if it is back.
8: [해제] Remove Mother's Wrath from the two Territorial Matriarchs with Soothe.
[우선 처치] While Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward shield is up, the whole group takes 24246 Nature every 2 sec, so focus Starsurge on the Rumbler to break the shield first.
9: [차단] Frigid Mauler's Frigid Roar (3.5 sec cast) is slow and easy to kick. Put Solar Beam into the kick rotation, and if it hits you, shapeshift to clear the 50% haste and movement speed reduction (Wowhead).
[광역 피해] This is the second Bloodlust pull (Topicx). Press Incarnation: Chosen of Elune if it is back with your 1 min cooldown to burn through Terra Rumbler's shield and health quickly.
10: [광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after Bloodlust (Topicx). Line up Fury of Elune or Force of Nature here again.
[차단] Stop both Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar with Solar Beam, and if only one is left, stop it with Incapacitating Roar. If Frigid Roar hits you, shapeshift to clear the slow.
11: [우선 처치] Focus Starsurge on the Avatar of Determination first, then break Terra Rumbler's shield (Topicx).
[참고] You can shapeshift out of Glacial Tomb, but Wowhead says it is better to just break it. Stack and break each other's tombs, and shapeshift out only if you get trapped away from the group.
13: [차단] Put Solar Beam into the kick rotation for the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning (4 sec cast, 193965 Nature, up to 3 targets).
[광역 피해] The two Grizzled Warbringers alternate Primal Echo (stacking physical damage that ignores armor), so press Barkskin (1 min, 30% damage reduction for 12 sec) when the Echo stacks build.
14: [해제] Bestial Wrath on the three Bonded Beasttamers and the Loyal Saberfang is an Enrage, so remove it with Soothe (10 sec). If a fixating pet chases a party member while enraged, clear that pet's enrage first.
[우선 처치] Each Ruthless Totemcaller's Magma Totem deals 36368 Fire every 0.3 sec, so break the totems first with Starsurge (Topicx).
15: [광역 피해] This is a big 85-forces pull where four Grizzled Warbringers alternate Primal Echo. Use Incarnation: Chosen of Elune and your 1 min cooldown here, press Barkskin as Echo stacks build, then follow with Bear Form and Frenzied Regeneration (36 sec, heals 24% health over 3 sec).
[차단] Stop both Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning with Solar Beam, and remove Bestial Wrath with Soothe.
16: [차단] Put Solar Beam into the kick rotation for Loa Speaker Nanea's Lightning Bolt.
[우선 처치] Volatile Totems should be finished on the second wave (Topicx), so unless Nanea is around 10% health, spend Starsurge and Fury of Elune on the totems first.

1: [광역 피해] This pull takes the first corridor all the way to the Voidtouched Magi with Bloodlust, so press Incarnation: Chosen of Elune (3 min) together with Fury of Elune (1 min, Elune's Chosen build) or Force of Nature (1 min, Keeper of the Grove build) (Topicx).
[차단] The tank takes the first kick on Voidtouched Magi's Shadowbolt Volley (4 sec cast, 193965 Shadow within 60 yards), so take the second kick with Solar Beam (1 min) (Topicx).

[해제] Feral Saberon's Feral Rage (20% melee haste to nearby allies) is an Enrage, so remove it with Soothe (10 sec). If targeted by Null Eruption, move out of the group and press Barkskin (1 min, 30% damage reduction for 12 sec).
2: [우선 처치] When Raj'kess the Spellstorm summons 3 Orbs of Disruption, switch immediately and break the orbs with Starsurge. If even one cast finishes, the whole group loses a lot of haste (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Press Barkskin for Thundering Storm's long group damage, and stand apart from other players so Forked Lightning (77586 Nature, bounces to 2 more) does not jump.
3: [광역 피해] At 158 forces this is the biggest pull. Press Barkskin for Chitigoth's Insidious Aura (87284 Nature to everyone every 2 sec for 10 sec), and if Barkskin is not back, shift to Bear Form and survive with Frenzied Regeneration (36 sec, heals 24% health over 3 sec) (Topicx).
[우선 처치] When Brutok hits a wall and is stunned for 5 sec by Concussion, line up Fury of Elune or Force of Nature, and add Incarnation: Chosen of Elune if it is back (Topicx).
[해제] Remove Feral Rage from the five Feral Saberons with Soothe. If Angry Krolusk's Violent Sand (40% slow for 12 sec) hits you, shapeshift to clear the slow (Wowhead).
5: [차단] Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek (3.5 sec cast, 6 sec fear within 60 yards) is the most important kick in this area (Topicx). Put Solar Beam into the kick rotation, and if Solar Beam is not back, step within 10 yards and stop it with Incapacitating Roar (30 sec, 3 sec incapacitate).
[광역 피해] If Watchful Harrower's Void Beam (43642 Shadow every 0.5 sec for 4 sec) targets you, move out of the group and press Barkskin (Topicx).
6: [우선 처치] Brutal Overseer's Brutal Slams shield must be broken quickly with damage cooldowns, so line up Fury of Elune or Force of Nature on the shield and focus Starsurge. Kill it before its next shield so it does not overlap with a Sky Strike soak (Topicx).
[광역 피해] If the shield lasts and Brutal Slams (48491 Physical to everyone every 1.5 sec, +10% per slam) stacks up, press Barkskin.
8: [광역 피해] Use damage cooldowns on this pull (Topicx). Press Incarnation: Chosen of Elune and your 1 min cooldown, but when the Devouring Brutalizer starts Devour (9 sec cast), focus Starsurge on the marked low-health mob and kill it before the cast ends (Topicx).
[차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Solar Beam.
[광역 피해] Press Barkskin for Dreadbellow (knockback plus 29095 Shadow every sec for 12 sec, cannot be dispelled).
9: [광역 피해] Drop Starfall once the 10 Scavenging Siphoids are stacked to kill them together, and kill the Devour target first with Starsurge.
[차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Solar Beam, and if the Solar Beam from pull 8 (1 min) is not back, stop it with Incapacitating Roar.
10: [광역 피해] If Devouring Brutalizer's Dreadbellow overlaps with Watchful Harrower's Void Beam, press Barkskin, then follow with Bear Form and Frenzied Regeneration. Press Incarnation: Chosen of Elune if it is back so the Brutalizer dies before its next ability (Topicx).
[해제] Remove Feral Rage from the two Feral Saberons with Soothe.

1: [광역 피해] This is the first pull of the dungeon and Bloodlust goes out, so press Incarnation: Chosen of Elune (3 min) together with Fury of Elune (1 min, Elune's Chosen build) or Force of Nature (1 min, Keeper of the Grove build).

[광역 피해] Press Barkskin (1 min, 30% damage reduction for 12 sec) for Shadow-Borne Champion's Shadow Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 164870 Shadow to the whole group). If Barkskin is not back for the next cast, shift to Bear Form and take it with Frenzied Regeneration (36 sec, heals 24% health over 3 sec).
[해제] When the Champion activates Ancestral Fury (150% damage done, Enrage), remove it with Soothe (10 sec).
2: [차단] Put Solar Beam (1 min) into the kick rotation for Risen Hexer's Hex Volley (3.5 sec cast, Shadow damage plus a 12 sec curse). Clear the curse with Remove Corruption (8 sec) if a cast gets through (Wowhead).

[광역 피해] This pack is a cooldown pull (Topicx). Incarnation: Chosen of Elune was used on pull 1, so line up Fury of Elune or Force of Nature (1 min each). Press Barkskin for Shadow Whirlwind and Soothe the Champion's Ancestral Fury.
4: [차단] Use Solar Beam (1 min) on Queen Wasi's Bind Soul (10 sec charm). Leave Soul Bolt and Seneschal M'bara's Unholy Mending to the other kickers.
[해제] When Queen Patlaa activates Bestial Berserk (25% movement, attack and cast speed, Enrage), remove it with Soothe (10 sec).

[광역 피해] When the hardest group, King A'akul with the Bloodsworn Assassins, wakes up, press Incarnation: Chosen of Elune if it is back together with Fury of Elune or Force of Nature. Press Barkskin when Sudden Rupture (18 sec bleed) is on you.
5: [광역 피해] Press Barkskin for Purification Construct's Purifying Flame (174568 Fire to the whole group). If the healer cannot keep up while you back out of the fire, use Heart of the Wild (2 min) while not shapeshifted to put an empowered group heal on up to 5 allies within 30 yards.

[해제] Embalming Fluid's Putrid Seekers (Nature DoT and 20% slow, Poison) can be removed with Remove Corruption. If your group uses Bloodlust here on a high key, line up Incarnation: Chosen of Elune with it.
6: [차단] Take one of the two Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge kicks (4 sec cast, 12 sec disease). If both are stacked at the tank, one Solar Beam silences both for 8 sec; if Solar Beam is down, stop both with Incapacitating Roar (30 sec, 3 sec incapacitate) from within 10 yards.
7: [차단] Kick the two Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge with Solar Beam or Incapacitating Roar. If you used Solar Beam on pull 6, check that 1 min has passed first.
[광역 피해] Clear the 8 Embalming Fluids with Starfall, and remove the Putrid Seekers poison from party members with Remove Corruption.
9: [우선 처치] Focus Starsurge on the two Spectral Shamans and kill them first. While a Shaman lives, Healing Tide Totems keep coming.

2: [차단] If the Solar Beam from pull 1 is not back, step within 10 yards and stop Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Incapacitating Roar (30 sec, 3 sec incapacitate).
[광역 피해] If Barkskin is down for Excavating Blast, shift to Bear Form and take it with Frenzied Regeneration (36 sec, heals 24% health over 3 sec).
3: [차단] Stop Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Solar Beam or Incapacitating Roar.
[우선 처치] Defier Draghar is a crowd-control-immune miniboss. If Incarnation: Chosen of Elune (3 min) is back, use it on Draghar with Fury of Elune or Force of Nature.
5: [차단] Interrupts go to Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt first (Topicx). If both are stacked at the tank, one Solar Beam silences them together.

[광역 피해] Press Barkskin for Blazebound Destroyer's Inferno (Fire damage to the group plus a 5 sec DoT).
6: [광역 피해] Flamegullet is immune to crowd control and its Molten Blood group damage keeps growing below 50%. On 17+ keys Bloodlust goes out at 50% (Topicx); line up Incarnation: Chosen of Elune and Fury of Elune or Force of Nature with it to kill it fast.

7: [차단] Silence both Primalist Cinderweavers' Cinderbolt with Solar Beam, and stop Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Incapacitating Roar when the stunner cannot.
[광역 피해] If Barkskin is not back for Inferno, take it with Bear Form and Frenzied Regeneration.
10: [광역 피해] Kill the six Storm Warriors with Lunar Eclipse and Starfall, and time Fury of Elune or Force of Nature for this pull.
[광역 피해] Press Barkskin if targeted by Tempest Channeler's Lightning Torrent (7 sec channel, 65463 Nature every sec).
[제어] Stop Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Incapacitating Roar when the stunner cannot.
11: [차단] Kick Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt with Solar Beam.
[광역 피해] If you used Barkskin on pull 10, take this chained pull's Lightning Torrent with Bear Form and Frenzied Regeneration.
12: [우선 처치] When High Channeler Ryvati activates Tempest Stormshield (absorbs 20% of max health), everyone within 60 yards is stunned for 4 sec if it expires unbroken. Press Incarnation: Chosen of Elune if it is back and stack Fury of Elune or Force of Nature and Starsurge on the shield to break it fast.
[광역 피해] While the shield is up the whole group takes Nature damage every sec, so press Barkskin. If targeted by Lightning Torrent, follow with Bear Form and Frenzied Regeneration.

1: [차단] Once the tank has gathered the three Storm Adepts, drop Solar Beam (1 min) to silence their Lightning Bolt together for 8 sec. Sandfury Stonefist's Ground Pound overlapping a Lightning Bolt kills people (Topicx), so you may hold Solar Beam for the Ground Pound cast.

[광역 피해] Press Barkskin (1 min, 30% damage reduction for 12 sec) for Ground Pound (4 sec cast, 156627 Physical plus knockback, 60 yards). Also keep Barkskin in mind for when Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage (9 sec channel) targets you (Wowhead).
[해제] Remove Shrouded Fang's Poisoned Cheap Shot (5 sec stun plus poison) right away with Remove Corruption (8 sec).
2: [차단] Silence both Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt with Solar Beam if it is back; otherwise stop them with Incapacitating Roar (30 sec, 3 sec incapacitate) from within 10 yards.

[광역 피해] If Barkskin is not back for Ground Pound, shift to Bear Form and take it with Frenzied Regeneration (36 sec, heals 24% health over 3 sec). Clear the two Shrouded Fangs' Poisoned Cheap Shot poison with Remove Corruption.
4: [우선 처치] If Sand-Sworn Rider lives long, its Swarming Krolusks run at distant DPS, so kill it first with Fury of Elune (1 min, Elune's Chosen build) or Force of Nature (1 min, Keeper of the Grove build) and Starsurge.
[회피] Serrated Charge knocks you back, so stand with a wall behind you if targeted, and press Barkskin when the bleed overlaps other damage (Wowhead).
5: [광역 피해] With 91 trash count this is a big pull, so press Incarnation: Chosen of Elune (3 min) together with Fury of Elune or Force of Nature. Time the cooldowns for when the Rider joins from the top of the bridge.
[차단] Lightning Bolt from the two Storm Adepts kills anyone also hit by a Krolusk leap or Cytotoxin (Topicx), so silence both together with Solar Beam.
[회피] If Barbed Krolusk's Serrated Charge targets you, keep a wall behind you and press Barkskin (Wowhead).
6: [차단] Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind (5 sec cast) needs only one kicker (Topicx). Be that kicker with Solar Beam, and clear the curse with Remove Corruption if a cast gets through.
[차단] Stop Brood Tender's Venom Bolt with Incapacitating Roar when Solar Beam is down.
7: [차단] Kick Brood Tender's Venom Bolt with Solar Beam so it does not land on top of Cytotoxin (Topicx), and stop Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind with Incapacitating Roar or clear the curse with Remove Corruption.
[회피] If Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage (9 sec channel, 43642 Physical every 0.8 sec) targets you, press Barkskin (Wowhead).
9: [차단] Silence both Imbued Stormcallers' Lightning Bolt with Solar Beam. Do not let kicks slip while Release Charge is hitting the group (Topicx).

[광역 피해] Press Barkskin for Agitated Nimbus's Release Charge (145474 Nature to the whole group), and use Bear Form and Frenzied Regeneration for the second Nimbus's Release Charge. Clear the Static Anomalies with Starfall.
10: [차단] Stop the two Imbued Stormcallers before gathering anything else (Topicx). Drop Solar Beam on both if it is back; otherwise use Incapacitating Roar.

[광역 피해] Press Barkskin for Release Charge, and if the healer is busy dispelling Imbued Conduction, use Heart of the Wild (2 min) while not shapeshifted to put an empowered group heal on up to 5 allies within 30 yards. Aim Fury of Elune or Force of Nature at the Nimbus.
12: [제어] Interrupt the Essence Disruption channel of the Temple Disruptor on the far side of the orb with Solar Beam and keep it silenced for 8 sec. Neither Balance Mythic+ build has long-lasting crowd control, so kill it with Starsurge before the silence ends.
[광역 피해] Press Barkskin for Orb Watcher's Caustic Stomp (116379 Nature plus a 10 sec DoT, 60 yards).
13: [제어] If Solar Beam from pull 12 is not back, stop the Temple Disruptor next to the tank with Incapacitating Roar and leave the far Disruptor to another kicker. If Barkskin is down for Caustic Stomp, take it with Bear Form and Frenzied Regeneration.
14: [차단] Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock must be kicked. The Hexxer is immune to crowd control, so put Solar Beam into the kick rotation.

[제어] Place Ursol's Vortex (1 min) on the four Faithless Tormentors that fixate the healer and kill them with Starfall. If one is about to reach the healer, knock it back and slow it by 50% with Typhoon (30 sec).
